name: Madison
gaps: Partial. Madison polygons are the SpatialDataLogic 2024 county extract. Acreage is land square feet divided by 43560, 5.0–150.0 inclusive. FDOR 2025 fills blank owner, value, DOR use, and roll-year sale by PARCEL_ID. CO_NO=50 is the FDOR county number.

County future land use is the zoning-equivalent district under the land-development code, but the county map is render-only. These rows use the UF GeoPlan 2008 statewide broad land-use categories, not current zoning.
The property appraiser link is a search page. The GSA detail host was not verified, so the parcel id is not put in the URL.
FDOR 2025 joined 7209/7266 parcel ids. County-number-only filters were not used.
2008 statewide broad land-use categories, not current zoning joined 7204/7266.
